title: Recruitment Drive
start: Talk to Sir Amik Varze on the floor 3 in the White Knights' Castle in Falador.

items.t: Store all equipment and anything in your inventory to be able to start the puzzles

recommended.t: Being a female character to defeat Sir Leye (this is not a safe death for hardcore ironman accounts).

Players are highly recommended to turn into a female character in order to complete the quest without difficulty. Alternatively, players may simply home teleport out of Sir Leye's room - however this can take a long time and can happen multiple times - as home teleporting won't reset your quest progress, allowing them to finish the quest while being a male character.

kills.t: Sir Leye (level 7) without weapons or armour.

rewards.t: Access to Initiate Temple Knight armour. You will be given a helmet (Initiate sallet) for free, and you can buy subsequent helmets for 6,000 coins, the legs (Initiate cuisse) for 8,000 coins, the platebody (Initiate hauberk) for 10,000 coins, and the full set for 20,000 coins. It looks just like White armour, only with a light gold trim and a different helmet visor.

steps.t: Teleport to Falador.
Go to the White Knights' Castle, and head up to the floor 3 of the western tower.
p: A player before and after a gender change from the Makeover Mage.

steps.t: Talk to Sir Amik Varze. [Chat: 2 I seek a quest! › Accept]
Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien without any items equipped or in the inventory. He can be found in the Falador Park. [Chat: 3 Yes, let's go!]
Optionally, sit on the bench next to Sir Tiffy Cashien to complete the achievement: Tiffy Time.
In this room there will be eleven statues when there should be twelve. The goal is to study the statues then, when the twelfth one is returned, pick the one that was originally missing.

sub.t: Easy method: look for the colour (bronze, silver, gold) of statue that only has 2 statues instead of 3, then note which weapon of that colour is missing out of the 4 possibilities (sword, halberd, great axe, or mace.)
Alternative method: the moment it shows 12 statues, take a screenshot. Then open the screenshot and compare which was missing and click it.

p: A room with statues of knights

steps.t: Find the statue that wasn't there originally and touch it.
As a female character, kill Sir Leye.

sub.t: If you have not visited the Makeover Mage before starting the quest, you can change your gender via the Customisation interface, under the Appearance tab.

p: The challenge room of Sir Kuam Ferentse.

steps.t: In this room, the chicken, grain, and the fox must all be transported to the other side of the bridge in a specific order.
Take the chicken across and put it down. In order to put down an object, open your equipment panel and click on the equipped object.
Take the fox across and put it down. Grab the chicken and return back.
Drop the chicken and take the Grain across.
Drop the grain and return back.
Take the chicken across and drop it.
Search the most south-western bookshelf for a knife.
Search all four of the most southern shelves with vials, take all of them.
Search the north-eastern middle-sized crate next to the chest for a tin.
Search the four northern shelves for the remaining vials, take all of them.
Pick up the metal spade on the table.
Use the metal spade on the bunsen burner in the room.
Use the metal spade on the door.
Use cupric sulphate on the door.
Use a vial of liquid on the door.
Pull on the spade to open the door.
Use the gypsum on the tin.
Use a vial of liquid on the tin.
Use the tin on the key chained to the south-western wall.
Use the cupric ore powder on the tin.
Use the tin ore powder on the tin.
Heat the tin on the bunsen burner.
Use a knife, bronze wire, or chisel on the tin.
Walk-through the open first door.
Unlock the door with the bronze key.
Talk to Sir Ren Itchood.
The first letter of each line he says is the answer to the door's lock.
Possible combinations are: BITE, FISH, LAST, MEAT, RAIN, or TIME.
Talk to Ms. Hynn Terprett.
She will give you a riddle.
After you talk to him, do not move, stand there and do nothing until he talks again. Do not take the hourglass.
After all the puzzles are done, quest complete!
